ruling.explanation:
To both parties — Rider RDR-09758 and Driver DRV-09758. This decides the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged for trip TRP-02758 on 16 August 2026. The fee stands, the driver is compensated SGD 3.60, and no referral issues. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, the amount_sgd figure (SGD 3.60) is the same as the driver-compensation figure: it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider (POL-GEN-03).

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires four conditions and all four are met on the record. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02758 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 10:43:34. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02758 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone pickup geofence at 10:43:34 — the first in-geofence fix carries that same timestamp — and reports 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes, so the POL-NS-02 arrival test is met. (c) He held position there continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s; the computed shortfall is −260 s, i.e. a surplus of 260 s). (d) No boarding is recorded and he terminated the trip at 10:50:57 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — well after the required dwell elapsed.

No rider-side clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, so this is not a wrong-entrance case. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the 'arrived' marker is not false, because the first in-geofence fix is at the marker's own timestamp and the driver was stationary rather than travelling at 15 km/h or more, so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not apply: the 440-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund, and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02758-01 (weight 0.0) is beside the point because no separate in-geofence intervals need summing.

Your message, Rider. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. Two of its three limbs hold — you sent a locating message at 10:44:14 ('im at the pickup, cant see you') and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made an in-app call — but limb (c) could not be run at all, because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable and neutral, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The unanswered message is not held against you; it simply cannot carry the test that would have helped you. Your filing that the driver 'never showed up' is contradicted by the trace and the platform's own wait-timer events.

Compensation. POL-NS-07 sets the driver's payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d = 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0 ÷ 70 completed trips = 0.00 (not above 0.08). The fare ledger EV-FARE-02758 shows the fee charged (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

Confidence and review. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other; no repeat-party pattern (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0); the anti-farming limb does not trip; and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) — the trace has 100% coverage, no gap over 120 s and 92 fixes, and the chat log matches chat_message_count = 1 with intact sequence numbering. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor; the cap is 1.00, since the deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-02758, EV-TRIP-02758 and EV-FARE-02758, each at weight 1.00. Two claims citing the missing advisory were discarded by the referee for not naming its issue code; they are recorded in the audit and carry no weight here.

The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
